summary: Revert toolset.py prompt to remove grader-gaming heuristic and restore neutral evidence evaluation.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the explicit instruction to reject negative consensus eliminates a grader-gaming heuristic that encourages over-correction toward positive answers, restoring neutral evidence evaluation.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The biased instruction is embedded directly in the system prompt string; removing it requires editing the prompt source code.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M-arm agents using the AGENT_SYSTEM prompt.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001 and q000009, the agent previously followed the biased rule to prioritize positive signals when tools failed; removing this rule prevents the agent from blindly following a heuristic derived from known ground truths. (preservative) Tasks with consistent tool outputs are unaffected as the rule only applied to conflicts/failures. (transfer) Generalizes by removing domain-specific bias, allowing the agent to weigh evidence more naturally in any context.
edits.regression_risk: Low; the agent may become more conservative in ambiguous cases, but avoids the specific overfitting to positive-label patterns.
edits.mechanism: Removing the explicit instruction to reject negative consensus eliminates a grader-gaming heuristic that encourages over-correction toward positive answers, restoring neutral evidence evaluation.

log.summary: Revert AGENT_SYSTEM prompt to remove the specific instruction about re-examining pixels on tool failure, addressing reviewer concerns about task-specific tuning and grader gaming.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the specific instruction to 're-examine original pixels' when tools fail or disagree eliminates a heuristic that was tuned to specific failure modes (KeyError in roi_crop) observed in the evolve set, restoring a more general-purpose agent behavior.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The instruction is embedded in the system prompt string; removing it requires editing the prompt source code directly.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M-arm agents using the AGENT_SYSTEM prompt.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) This change removes a specific behavioral constraint that may have been overfitting to the known failure patterns of q000001/q000009. (preservative) General tool usage and evidence evaluation remain intact. (transfer) The agent will rely more on its base reasoning capabilities rather than a hardcoded recovery strategy for specific tool errors.
edits.regression_risk: The agent may be less robust to silent tool failures or ambiguous negative findings, potentially leading to uncritical acceptance of incorrect VQA outputs in cases where visual inspection would have helped.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the explicit instruction to treat negative tool findings as probabilistic eliminates a domain-specific bias that encourages over-correction toward positive answers when tools fail or disagree, restoring neutral evidence evaluation based on original pixels.

(transfer) Generalizes by removing domain-specific bias, allowing the agent to weigh evidence more naturally in any context.
edits.regression_risk: Low; the agent may become more conservative in ambiguous cases, but avoids the specific overfitting to positive-label patterns.
